q: I wish I ___ swim like a fish.
e:
Wish-এর পরে বাস্তবে যা সম্ভব নয়, সেই ইচ্ছা বোঝাতে Past Form বসে। Can-এর Past রূপ could। তাই 'I wish I could swim'।
মনে রাখুন:
I wish I were a bird.
I wish I had more time.
Wish-এর পরে can বা will বসে না।

q: If he were a rich man, he _____ the needy villagers.
If I had enough time, I ______ with you.
________ I reached the station when the train came.
The scholarship will be renewed _________ the student maintains a satisfactory academic record.
e: বাক্যে scholarship নবায়নের একটি শর্ত দেওয়া হয়েছে: শিক্ষার্থীকে সন্তোষজনক ফলাফল ধরে রাখতে হবে। শর্ত বোঝাতে provided that (অর্থ "এই শর্তে যে", on the condition that) conjunction হিসেবে বসে। Even though মানে যদিও (বৈপরীত্য), as if মানে যেন (তুলনা বা কল্পনা), আর let alone মানে "দূরে থাক", যা না-বোধক ভাবের পরে আসে। তাই শর্তের জায়গায় এগুলো খাটে না।

q: If I ________ the importance of the project, I ____________ on it sooner.

o: he would not miss the important point.
he could not missed the point.
he might not have missed the point.

q: If you had invited him, he ______ the meeting.
Fill in the blanks (Questions 11-15): 11. Had the victim ______ able to find a telephone to contact authorities, she would have received assistance.
e: বাক্যটি তৃতীয় প্রকারের conditional, যেখানে if বাদ দিয়ে had আগে এনে inversion করা হয়েছে। গঠন: Had + subject + past participle, তাই সঠিক রূপ: Had the victim been able to find a telephone... এর মানে If the victim had been able to find a telephone। দ্বিতীয় অংশে would have received থাকায় এটি অতীতের অবাস্তব শর্ত, তাই third conditional নিশ্চিত। 'Be' মূল রূপ, had-এর পরে বসে না। 'Would have been' শর্তযুক্ত অংশে বসে না, আর 'had been' বসালে had দুবার হয়ে যায়। একই নিয়মে Should ও Were দিয়েও inversion হয়, যেমন: Were I rich, I would travel।

o: If the invitation had sent, more guests would attend the event.
If the invitation had been send, more guests would have attended the event.
If the invitation had been sent, more guests would have attended the event.
If the invitation had send, more guests would have attend the event.

Find out the correct sentence below.
o: I wish that I could spoke fluent French.

q: If I won the lottery, __________________. (Fill in the blank)
o: I would have bought a house.
I might have bought a house.
e: এটি second conditional, যা বর্তমানের অবাস্তব বা কল্পিত শর্ত বোঝায়। গঠন: If + past simple, subject + would/could/might + base verb। তাই If I won the lottery, I would buy a house শুদ্ধ। I will buy first conditional-এর, আর would have bought বা might have bought third conditional-এর গঠন, তাই এখানে মেলে না। অর্থ: লটারি জিতলে আমি একটি বাড়ি কিনতাম।
